items.title: American Express’ Q2 Revenue Miss Versus Peers Might Change The Case For Investing In AXP
items.summary: In Q2, American Express reported revenue of US$18.55 billion, up 12.8% year on year but about 5.8% below analyst expectations, making it the weakest performer versus estimates among major credit card peers that largely exceeded forecasts.
